body:
Worker trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-30 04:26Z, my own slip on w-2144 round 2 GREEN2, test-a147a75a). `cargo test --bin termal A B C` is INVALID: cargo accepts only ONE TESTNAME before `--` ("error: unexpected argument 'B' found"). The run fails in about 1 s with no test executed, and it still costs a recorded failed run.
Multiple libtest filters MUST go after `--`: `cargo test --bin termal -- A B C`.
Before staging any author's command, check it for this form. A single filter before `--` is fine, and so is `-- --exact A B` with several.
A related trap from the same night: a list guard for a NAME-PREFIX filter (for example resume_evidence_regression) must not require "filter::"; names may continue with "_".
